# Parity fixtures

Machine-readable oracles extracted from the Python implementation; the Rust
port asserts equality against them. Fixtures are generated, never
hand-edited — if a fixture disagrees with the Rust code, the Rust code is
wrong until proven otherwise.

## `themes/` (Phase 1)

Generated by `rust/lace-core/codegen/emit_goldens.py` (run from repo root
with the dev venv):

| Fixture | Source oracle |
|---|---|
| `<name>.json` × 27 | `build_theme()` output for `default` (= `BASE_DOCK_DEFAULTS`) + the 26 `THEME_SPECS`, keys lower-cased, sorted. Covers focused + unfocused tokens alike (`focus_border_color`, `border_active_color`, `border_unfocused_color`). |
| `_groups.json` | `theme_groups()` presentation order (labels + keys). |
| `_resolved_default_<category>.json` × 8 | `DockStyleManager.get_all()` per category after `apply_theme("default")`: schema defaults merged under the engine output, colours as `[r,g,b,a]`, unset tokens as `null`. |

Regenerate after any change to `lace/dock_theme.py`,
`lace/dock_custom_theme.py`, or the schemas, then re-run
`cargo test -p lace-core`.

## `layouts/` (Phase 2)

Generated by `rust/lace-core/codegen/emit_layouts.py`: five positive
scenarios built by a real `DockManager` headless (transient float ids
normalized to `float-N`), the pre-schema `legacy` variant, and eight
hand-mutated negatives.

| Fixture | Scenario |
|---|---|
| `docked_tabs.json` | tabbed area (current=Gamma) + bottom split |
| `closed.json` | a closed tab stays closed |
| `locked.json` | `locked_name` + `locked_to_area` survive |
| `floating.json` | floating window + explicit geometry |
| `sidebar.json` | pinned widget + sidebar block |
| `legacy.json` | `QtAdvancedDockingSystem`, no `schema` (reads as v0, warns) |
| `wrong_type` / `missing_keys` | rejected at parse |
| `future_schema` / `version_mismatch` | rejected at validate |
| `bad_geometry_zero/huge/type` | rejected at validate |
| `sizes_mismatch` / `unnamed_widget` | `RestoreFailure`: live layout untouched |

0.7.x `save_state()` outputs for the serializer roundtrips
(`tests/test_layout_roundtrip.py`, `test_area_insertion.py`).
